correctness.rationale: The norm is exactly the maximum of three absolute linear forms, so its unit sphere has six affine edges. Conditioning on signed active support forms for the two isosceles sums makes orthogonality linear on each support cell. Every feasible nondegenerate cell is a segment, and there are no feasible cells with identically vanishing orthogonality equality. The objective is convex on each cell, hence is maximized at a cell endpoint. Exact rational enumeration gives 48 distinct endpoints and 12 quadratic candidates. Symbolic interval comparison proves the stated two-branch envelope, and an explicit orthogonal pair attains it. The checker reproduces these statements using exact fractions.
